 First look at Netflix's new Stranger Things spin-off series
 Greg Evans Saturday 07 November 2026 09:27 EST 
 Bookmark popover
 Removed from bookmarks
 Close popover Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure trailer Netflix has announced a new Stranger Things prequel spin-off series, Other Worlds: A Stranger Things Adventure, which is scheduled for release in 2028. 
 The upcoming series will take place in Marion, Nevada, in the 1950s, predating the 1980s setting of the original show and the 1959-set stage play The First Shadow. 
 Showrunner Kate Trefry and creators the Duffer Brothers are returning to helm the project, which will feature a new cast of heroes and villains. 
 A short teaser trailer for the spin-off was released on 6 November to coincide with the franchise's annual Stranger Things Day. 
 The main Stranger Things series originally premiered on Netflix in 2016 before concluding with a final episode in January 2026.
